Founded by veterinarian, Dr. James St.Clair, TopDog Health has been to providing essential and trusted educational materials and joint supplements to pet owners whose dogs have undergoing orthopedic surgery or are suffering from age-related and genetic joint health issues. In combination with our top rated joint supplements including GlycanAid HA, GlycanAid Maintenance, and Flexerna Omega, we will help your dog get better, feel better, and stay better! 

Has your dog undergone TPLO – Tibial Plateau Leveling Osteotomy, TTA – Tibial Tuberosity Advancement, CCL– Cranial Cruciate Ligament Rupture or dog ACL surgery, MPL – Medial Patellar Luxation, FHO – Femoral Head Osteotomy, THR – Total Hip Replacement or does your dog suffer from arthritis and other orthopedic conditions? You've come to the right place!

Visit us at topdoghealth.com and use coupon code YOUTUBE at checkout for 20% OFF + FREE SHIPPING on your first order. 
Join Our Support Group: facebook.com/groups/TopDogSupport
